turns.requestSummary: Outline a reader that reveals supporting detail only when it is useful.

root.content: Lead with a self-contained answer, then attach supporting branches that remain available without competing for attention.

children.content: Keep the central claim visible while deeper evidence opens independently.
Expansion should be local and instant because every branch is already part of the committed answer.
Use a restrained visual hierarchy so structure is apparent before any control is pressed.

turns.requestSummary: Add contextual definitions without turning the page into a glossary.

answer.title: Definitions should stay beside the thought

root.content: Mark only terms whose local meaning matters. A [context note](term:context-note) opens beside the phrase and closes without changing the answer tree.

children.content: Definitions belong to the turn that introduced them, preventing an older meaning from leaking into a newer answer.
Keyboard focus returns to the marked phrase after the note closes.

terms.context-note: A short definition scoped to one answer turn and shown only when its marked phrase is activated.

turns.requestSummary: Make the reader useful across many sessions while preserving the focused answer experience.

answer.title: The answer becomes a durable transcript

root.content: The [Semantic Answer Tree](term:semantic-answer-tree) now keeps immutable turns inside their source sessions. The sidebar moves between conversations; the transcript keeps request context directly above each structured answer.

children.content: The latest turn keeps the familiar reading frontier open. Historical turns begin with their root answer and reveal branches when selected.
Expand, collapse, and copy controls apply only to the selected turn, so actions never spill into nearby history.
Earlier pages load upward without moving the sentence already under the reader's eye.
Only a bounded window of turns remains mounted, with explicit recovery toward newer history when needed.
Live updates follow automatically near the bottom. While reading older material, a quiet banner announces the committed turn instead of moving the page.

terms.semantic-answer-tree: A read-only, session-aware answer tree for structured SemanticAnswer version 1 documents.

turns.requestSummary: Propose a compact way to preserve findings from several small experiments.

answer.title: Record the decision, evidence, and next check

root.content: Each note should state what changed, what observation supports it, and what would disprove the current conclusion.

children.content: Keep raw measurements linked but separate from the short decision record.
Name the next check precisely enough that another person can run it.

turns.requestSummary: Explain how later findings should relate to earlier notes without rewriting history.

answer.title: Append the correction; preserve the evidence trail

root.content: Treat each finding as an immutable turn. A later result can supersede an interpretation while the original observation remains readable in sequence.

children.content: Use the request summary to show why each follow-up occurred.
Make the newest conclusion easy to reach without hiding the path that produced it.
